newsitem.title: USA: Partner Re Q3 diluted shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Partner Re Q3 diluted shr rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers) Full company name is PartnerRe Ltd
NOTE: The company said despite an active storm season in 1996, its loss burden continued to be modest. Overall loss provision for 3Q 1996 was $9.2 million, it said.

Third quarter 96 fully diluted operating earnings exluded a $0.09 per share net investment loss, third quarter 1995 fully diluted operating earnings exclude $0.04 per share net investment gain, the first nine months 1996 operating fully diluted earnings exlude a $0.03 per share net investment loss and the first nine months 1995 fully diluted operating earnings exclude a $0.07 per share net investment gain.
